messages:
replay-bot: Live post-all-hands thread for leadership Q&A — drop short clarifying questions about mission, positioning, GTM, competitors.
jamie_ceo: Thanks all. I'll answer short ones here and follow up where needed.
harper_product: Quick product ask: with more focus on Dedicated, is our mission shifting away from self-serve?
jamie_ceo: No, mission unchanged. We're still developer-first; Dedicated/Private are about predictable economics and compliance for customers that need it.
olivia_cto: Tech addition: parity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private at the API and observability level is non-negotiable. That's what keeps migrations low friction.
nina_growth: For top-of-funnel, should messaging lead with "cost" or "reliability"? Which converts better?
samir_sales: From field notes: reliability wins with enterprise buyers; cost + speed converts developers. We should craft two tight lines.
leah_engineering: Competitor angle: prospects hear "proprietary model" pitches a lot — how should we respond in sales calls?
jamie_ceo: Don't do negative comparisons. Be concrete: present verified perf numbers, migration stories, and how our smart routing + caching reduces unit cost.
ben_sre: SLA detail: when we say "enterprise SLAs" for Dedicated, are those per-route SLOs or cluster guarantees?
olivia_cto: Per-route SLOs (p95/p99 examples) backed by cluster capacity and autoscaling policies. We'll include examples in the SLA docs.
harper_product: Action items: who drafts the one-pager, migration slide, and benchmark snippets?
jamie_ceo: Harper — one-pager; Samir — migration slide + incentives; Olivia — benchmark snippets & tech appendix. I'll review.
nina_growth: Marketing needs a 2-line elevator pitch and a 1-line sales blurb. Can we get variants for devs/infra/legal?
samir_sales: I'll prepare three variants and drop them in this thread by EOD Tue.
leah_engineering: Sales will also need a short bullet list for "hard-to-copy" tech: KV cache, smart routing, verified perf profiles.
olivia_cto: Adding a tiny tech appendix and a mini diagram. Will include p50/p95/p99 numbers for a couple common seq lengths.
jamie_ceo: Timeline: drafts by Wed EOD, leadership review Thu morning. If discussions get deep, spin into focused threads.
replay-bot: Note: please attach drafts to the shared drive link (internal) so owners can iterate.
jamie_ceo: Thanks everyone — keep it tight and actionable. :rocket:
